name: Himoto
aliases: Himoto, the Kami of the Spark
description: Himoto is a rare tanuki-shaped kami, also called Pompon-chan, who bonds with Kaito, sparks his planeswalking and accompanies him as a drone and mask.

timeline.summary: Tameshi explains the light was a unique kami being born, embodying the emperor's bond with Kyodai, and that he built the prototype to protect it.
timeline.quote: "The light you saw was a kami being born.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito hears Kyodai's voice and runs after it hoping the emperor has returned, but finds only the tanuki-shaped kami.
timeline.quote: Instead, he saw the tanuki-shaped kami, with glowing white eyes and translucent fur.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko breaks free and the siblings fight the Reckoners back to back while Tameshi fails to make the kami merge with the robot.
timeline.quote: "What happened to 'no weapons'?"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: The Order of Jukai arrives and battles the Reckoners, letting the group escape with the kami.
timeline.quote: The Order of Jukai had arrived.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Gravelighter attacks the fleeing group; Kaito shields Eiko and Himoto, and Himoto commands Gravelighter to retreat.
timeline.quote: No—not a cry. A command .

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Himoto refuses to go to the palace with Eiko; Kaito names her Pompon-chan and vows to find the emperor.
timeline.quote: "I vote we call her Pompon-chan for now,"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Himoto bonds with the tanuki prototype and tells Kaito her name.
timeline.quote: "She says her name is Himoto."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito dons the tanuki mask and feels a surge of power, and Kaito vanishes from Kamigawa as a new planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Kaito took a step forward and vanished from Kamigawa.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito, now a planeswalker, returns to Towashi in his mask, resolved to keep searching the Multiverse for the emperor.
timeline.quote: There were many more planes to search.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito, now a planeswalker, scouts Towashi with his tanuki drone Himoto and spots Imperial samurai outside an apartment with a window left ajar.
timeline.quote: Kaito nudged the drone skyward toward the height of the nearby buildings.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito tracks Tameshi to the Undercity docks and sends Himoto into a warehouse laboratory.
timeline.quote: Silently, she flew toward the warehouse.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito takes Tameshi's lab key card and leaves the blazing warehouse.
timeline.quote: he reached into his friend's pocket and removed the key card to his lab.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito sends Himoto to eavesdrop and learns a kami has carried word of Otawara to a nezumi who will warn someone there.
timeline.quote: Yes. I'll warn her.

citation.work: Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance
citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito follows the nezumi's rabbit drone to Otawara.
timeline.quote: The tanuki followed, and Kaito headed in the direction of Otawara.

citation.work: Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance
citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo track Tezzeret as he heads for the emperor and fight him on the rooftops, with Eiko's dagger striking him.
timeline.quote: In his thigh was a gleaming dagger, the gold handle carved with the symbol of the Imperials.

citation.work: Episode 5: Threads of War
citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks out a guard at the changing of the guard and picks the lock of the treasure room.
timeline.quote: Kaito moved behind the guard and hit him on the back of the head with the pommel of his sword.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds the scroll protected by a spider kami's spirit web and asks Himoto to unweave it.
timeline.quote: A spider kami hung above the scroll in a delicate spirit web

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
timeline.quote: The door's gone

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito steps toward the doorway and the floor opens into a toothed mouth; he falls into blackness as the Wanderer fails to catch him.
timeline.quote: The floor he stepped onto opened like the mouth of a lamprey

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 2: Don't Split the Party" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito falls through the floor with Himoto clinging to him.
timeline.quote: Himoto's claws dug into his shoulder as she anchored herself, refusing to be separated from him

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito lands on a forest floor beneath the ballroom, unhurt despite the fall.
timeline.quote: his descent ended in a hard impact with what felt like a forest floor.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The dragon's fire engulfs Kaito, and he finds himself on a burned plain beside a burning city, in what feels like a staged performance.
timeline.quote: it was a performance being put on for Kaito's benefit—or for the House's.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The vision tears like paper and Kaito stands in a basement with a dying candle light.
timeline.quote: he appeared to be standing in an underground room with rough stone walls and a staircase in one corner

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Himoto picks the locks on Jace's shackles.
timeline.quote: Himoto began working at the locks on Jace's shackles, manipulating the tumblers until they clicked open.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Drowning in gel, Kaito planeswalks back to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: and planeswalked away, back to Ravnica, back to the beginning, where he might yet survive.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.
